name: PropertyValuation
description: Records the result of the property valuation instructed by the bank in PH-012. The valuation_amount is the authoritative value used for LTV recalculation and underwriting. If valuation_amount < purchase_price, down_valuation_flag is set and EX-001 exception path is triggered. Owned by SVC-002.

fields.name: property_address
fields.validation_rule: Required. UK address object. Must match parent MortgageApplication.property_address.

fields.name: valuation_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required when status = completed. Positive decimal, GBP. Surveyor's assessed open market value.

fields.name: valuation_date
fields.validation_rule: Required when status = completed. ISO 8601. Must be <= 3 months at time of mortgage completion.

fields.name: surveyor_id
fields.validation_rule: Required for physical valuations. RICS surveyor ID or 'AVM' for desktop.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: instructed | in_progress | completed | failed | cancelled.

fields.name: down_valuation_flag
fields.validation_rule: Required when status = completed. true if valuation_amount < MortgageApplication.purchase_price.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status = completed.
